BiblicalUsage: tsᵉphîyr is the word the Bible uses when it means a he-goat. In Ezra 6:17, twelve he goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the he-goats of Ezra's dedication remind me that worship cost something real, not just words.
